title: Controlling the Probability of Unknown Unknowns in Pre-Deployment Testing of AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.15835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In pre-deployment testing of AI systems such as AI agents, a developer can often deal with known failure modes (e.g., leaking API keys, deleting important databases, or installing a malicious package) by implementing fixes or making contingency plans for when the same issue might occur again. What is more challenging are the unknown unknowns: the unseen failure modes that haven't surfaced during testing. The decision to stop testing and deploy therefore faces an inherent tradeoff: continue testing to observe more behaviors, at the cost of time and resources, or stop testing and deploy, at the risk of failure modes remaining undiscovered. translated_title: 控制AI系统部署前测试中“未知未知”的概率
translated_abstract: 在AI智能体等AI系统的部署前测试中，开发者通常可以通过实施修复措施或制定应急预案来处理已知的失效模式（例如泄露API密钥、删除重要数据库或安装恶意软件包），以应对同类问题再次发生的情况。更具挑战性的是“未知未知”：即在测试期间尚未显现、从未被观察到的失效模式。因此，何时停止测试并进行部署这一决策面临一种内在的权衡：继续测试以观察更多行为，需要付出时间和资源的代价；或者停止测试并部署，则要承担失效模式尚未被发现的风险。那么开发者应如何判断测试是否已经足够充分？为回答这一问题，我们开发了一种算法，该算法能够在观察到未见失效模式的概率足够小时提供认证。该算法为此量构造了任意时有效的置信上界序列，从而使开发者能够……
tldr: 提出一种基于任意时有效置信上界序列的算法，可在部署前测试中认证“出现未见失效模式”的概率已足够小，从而帮助开发者判断何时可以停止测试并安全部署AI系统。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an algorithm based on anytime-valid upper confidence sequences that certifies when the probability of observing an unseen failure mode is sufficiently small, guiding developers on when to stop pre-deployment testing and deploy AI systems.
